research.notes: The school's own website (baytechschool.org) blocks automated fetching, so contact details are taken from the California Department of Education school directory. The school also operates on an OUSD campus at 8251 Fontaine St, Oakland (per OUSD Prop 39 materials); the mailing address used here is the CDE-listed 1445 23rd Ave. California entity number and SAM UEI were not looked up.

profile.summary: Bay Area Technology School, known as BayTech, is a nonprofit that operates a public charter school in Oakland, California. The school serves students in grades 6 through 12 with a technology-focused, college preparatory program. It was founded in 2004.

review.notes: The agenda item is an OUSD Prop 39 facilities agreement with Bay Tech Charter School, and the sources show Bay Area Technology School (BayTech) is a 501(c)(3) running an Oakland charter school, so it is the same organization. ProPublica and the CDE directory support the legal name, EIN, address, phone, email, website, grades 6-12 and 2004 founding. Wikipedia supports the technology-focused college-prep description. The summary is neutral.
